args.title: Fix health check status code for degraded service
args.body:
File: src/api/health.ts

Change the health check endpoint to return a non-200 HTTP status code when the status is 'degraded'. This ensures the load balancer correctly treats degraded status as unhealthy instead of healthy.

args.title: Fix pickLocale to respect Accept-Language 'q' weights
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

Update the function pickLocale to properly parse and consider the quality (q) values in the Accept-Language header, so it chooses the preferred supported language based on user preference weights, not just the first matched language.

label: bug
file: src/api/health.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The health check endpoint in src/api/health.ts currently returns HTTP 200 even when the service status is 'degraded'. This causes load balancers to incorrectly consider the service as healthy. The fix changes the status code for degraded status to correctly indicate an unhealthy state.

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function pickLocale in src/i18n/index.ts does not respect the quality (q) weights in the Accept-Language header. This causes language preference to be ignored and the first matched language to be used instead, which can lead to incorrect language responses.

args.title: Document password length constraints in resetConfirmSchema
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

Add documentation for the password reset confirmation endpoint to specify that the password must be between 10 and 200 characters. This clarifies the 'validation failed' error and prevents user confusion.

The password reset confirmation endpoint requires passwords to be between 10 and 200 characters, but this was not documented in the API reference. The pull request adds this missing documentation to clarify the validation requirements and prevent confusion when users encounter a 'validation failed' error.

args.title: Fix token TTL environment variable parsing
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Change the code to correctly parse the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable from a string that may include units like '12h' into the appropriate integer number of minutes, rather than assuming it's always an integer in minutes. This prevents unintended defaults and incorrect token TTL values.

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The code in src/config.ts incorrectly assumes the TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable is always an integer minute value. It does not handle cases where the variable is set with a time unit suffix like '12h'. This causes the token TTL to default incorrectly, leading to unexpected logout timing.

args.title: Add name filter to reports list endpoint
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The reports list endpoint in src/api/reports.ts currently lists reports with pagination but does not support filtering by report name. Add a name filter to the GET /reports handler in this file to enable searching reports by their name as requested.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue requests adding a search box to find reports by name. The current reports list endpoint supports pagination but lacks a filter by report name. The proposed change adds a name filter to the GET /reports handler in src/api/reports.ts to fulfill this feature request.
